_meta.method: approval.decision_note where present; judgment from full payload.text otherwise. quality-class = the QG (LLM + deterministic gates) could and should have caught it: factual error, dup/flood, broken copy, voice violation, refusal/meta leak, fabrication. strategic-class = timing, topic choice, platform policy - not the QG's job. borderline=true marks judgment calls that could swing the other way.

modes.dup: near-duplicate copy or repeat-promo flood (CEO note 'duplicate/low-distinct promo' or burst pattern)
modes.voice: founder-voice violation: buzzwords, hype, rhetorical hooks, generic filler, rambling length
modes.broken_copy: unfilled placeholder, self-contradictory or nonsensical content
modes.meta_leak: revision/editor commentary leaked into the published payload
modes.refusal_leak: agent refusal text queued as the post payload
modes.fabrication: invented narrative/persona claims presented as fact
modes.timing: stale content - event reference no longer accurate
modes.platform_directive: platform removed from allowed task types by CEO directive
modes.topic_choice: legitimate copy, CEO didn't want the topic/angle posted
